**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** No blocker found. This is a process PR (xtask only), read and built locally.

## What looks good

- All five open items of #3711 are done: trait impl and `pub` after attributes in `quick_subs::filter`, a table test of `braces::code`, the rename `whole` to `outside_fns`, and a real `<sub>::` cargo run.
- `scan::test_fns` endless loop: closed in two ways. The attribute walk stops at a line that holds a fn (`scan.rs:104`). The loop also always moves on (`scan.rs:138`: `i = e.saturating_add(1).max(i.saturating_add(1))`). So the loop ends even if the walk is wrong in some other case.
- `fn_re` (`scan.rs:90`) now reads `pub(crate)`, `pub(in ..)`, `const`, `async`, `unsafe`, `extern "C"` fns. Pinned by `a_test_after_an_attributed_fn_on_one_line_is_found_and_the_scan_ends`.
- `braces::code`: `cr".."` and `cr#".."#` are raw strings. An escaped char literal (`'\''`, `'\'`, `'\n'`, `'\x41'`) now ends at its last quote (`i += 3`). I traced each form by hand. The 16-row table covers them.
- A decision file is present, the new test file has a provenance line, and the code has no `unwrap` or `panic` outside tests.
- Process rules: `Process change: yes` is in the body. `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` is not in the diff. The body has `Changelog: none` and `Fixes #3711`. No dependency, `build.rs`, `.github` or snapshot change.

## Results (merged with main `d54580cad`, "Already up to date": the head already holds it; built locally, with `CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=6`, `-j 6`)

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p xtask --bin xtask` | 322 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo test -p xtask --test '*'` (all integration binaries) | all ok (largest: 4 passed in 59 s, 3 passed in 29 s) |
| `cargo clippy -j 6 -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main --dry-run` | 1 step (xtask unit tests) |
| `cargo xtask gate release --dry-run` | 1297 steps, 101 heavy. The list of step names is the same as with the `scan.rs` and `quick_subs.rs` of main (checked with `diff`) |

## Heavy lanes

`cargo xtask gate heavy --base origin/main --dry-run` lists 0 steps: the diff reaches no heavy lane. Nothing was run.

## Red first (judged here)

The author says that red-first is partial. I ran each new pin on the old `scan.rs`, `quick_subs.rs` and `braces.rs` (the new tests kept, each run limited by `timeout 90`):

| Pin on the old code | Result |
|---|---|
| `a_mod_token_in_a_literal_or_comment_..` | red (`cr".."` row: lexer state `Str`, expected `Code`) |
| `a_test_after_an_attributed_fn_on_one_line_..` | hangs (stopped by the timeout, exit 124) |
| `a_trait_impl_or_a_scoped_pub_in_a_submodule_..` | red (plan kept the `alpha::` filter) |
| `an_inherent_impl_of_a_private_type_..`, `a_block_comment_and_a_string_carry_over_..`, `a_submodule_step_runs_only_that_submodule_in_real_cargo` | green on the old code, as designed (guards against a too-wide filter, and a first pin of a real run) |

This is acceptable: each pin of a new behaviour is red on the old code, and the green ones are guards. Only the later rows of the 8-case trait-impl table were not shown red one by one. The first case is red, and the regex change is one rule, so the risk is low.

## Not blocking

1. The loop pin hangs on a regression instead of failing (it needs unbounded memory, as the old code shows). The guard at `scan.rs:138` now closes the cause. If you want a pin that fails fast, run `test_fns` in a thread with a time limit. Optional.
2. The `shared` regex (`quick_subs.rs:28-30`) matches only at the start of a line. I ran a probe on the head: `struct A; impl std::fmt::Display for A {..}` on one line, `mod inner { impl Default for super::X {..} }` on one line, and `struct A; pub fn helper() {}` still keep the `alpha::` filter. The `pub` case was already so on main. rustfmt puts these items on their own lines, and the post-merge batch tier runs whole suites, so I do not block. If you want to close the class with one rule: match `pub\b` and `\bimpl\b[^{;]*\bfor\b` anywhere in the output of `braces::code` (which blanks strings and comments), not at line start. A new pin would use the three one-line forms above.
3. `xtask/src/directory_tests.rs` is 405 lines (403 on main). It was over 400 before; the growth is small.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
